title: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Austrian Foreign Minister Meinl-Reisinger
author: Office of the Spokesperson
summary:
Office of the Spokesperson

Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Austrian Foreign Minister Meinl-Reisinger

Readout

August 11, 2026

The following is attributable to Spokesperson Thomas Pigott: 

Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with Austrian Foreign Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger today in Washington.  The Secretary and Foreign Minister discussed ways to ensure European security and uphold national sovereignty, including protecting critical technologies.  Secretary Rubio welcomed Austria’s election to the UN Security Council and highlighted areas of shared interests.
